mechanism.claim: At fixed twice-daily decisions, simultaneous causal one-hour realized-variance shocks across at least four alts reveal a cross-asset risk repricing wave. When the shocked alts' completed one-hour displacements agree, BTC follows that variance-shock direction for eight hours during locally elevated variation.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the shocked-alt realized-variance-weighted one-hour displacement consensus
mechanism.why_distinct: Cojump candidates threshold individual five-minute return jumps; range-expansion and volume-shock candidates use price range or turnover; variation-dispersion candidates use cross-sectional compression. HVCAVS ranks each alt's aggregated one-hour quadratic variation against its own strictly prior scheduled history and requires broad directional agreement only among variance-shocked alts. It uses no lag beta, current BTC direction, post-entry fit, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed 24-hour realized variation ranks in the upper 35 percent against the 20 strictly prior scheduled source-valid decisions, adapting causally to local July-like volatility
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed 02:35 and 14:35 UTC entries with an eight-hour hold are absent from Gross9 primitive clocks

features.bars: exact five-minute OHLC aggregated from five consecutive bars_binance one-minute rows; all seven symbols complete, finite, positive, coherent; no imputation
features.decision_times: every calendar day at exact 02:30 and 14:30 UTC
features.alt_one_hour_realized_variance: sum squared five-minute returns over the 12 completed bars ending at decision
features.alt_one_hour_displacement: sum five-minute returns over those same 12 bars; finite strict nonzero for selected alt
features.variance_shock_rank: for each alt independently, strict-prior midrank of one-hour realized variance over at most 120 prior jointly valid scheduled decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; shocked when rank>=0.65
features.score: sum(one_hour_realized_variance*sign(one_hour_displacement) over shocked alts)/sum(one_hour_realized_variance over shocked alts)
features.consensus_gate: at least four shocked alts, abs(score)>=0.50, and at least three shocked displacement signs equal score sign
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC five-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over 20 prior jointly source-valid scheduled decisions, minimum 15, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-alt aggregated quadratic-variation shock propagation mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, aggregation, shock window, histories, ranks, consensus, local-volatility gate, direction, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
